max_seq_len_status: AUTO: computed at training time as the longest tokenized prompt+target in train+val, rounded up to a multiple of 64. Training aborts if that exceeds 1024 or if any example would be truncated. The tokenizer is not reachable from the CPU-side build environment, so the real length audit is written to logs/token_length_audit.json by train_qlora.py on Colab.

lora.note: Same LoRA settings as Week 3. Target module names are verified against the loaded model at training time.

quantization.note: FP16 compute because the T4 has no native BF16.

training.note: Effective batch 16 (2 x 8). 400 examples -> 25 optimizer steps/epoch, 75 total. Micro-batch 2 rather than Week 3's 4 because these sequences are longer; the effective batch matches Week 3. No hyperparameter search is run: this is the only configuration.
